description: This file contains shell functions related to network interface configuration within the OpenWrt project, including functions for finding, fixing, and preparing network interfaces, as well as making ubus calls and handling JSON data.

methods.name: find_config
methods.description: Finds a network interface configuration matching the given device name.

methods.name: unbridge
methods.description: A placeholder function that returns without action.

methods.name: ubus_call
methods.description: Makes a ubus call and loads JSON result into the context.

methods.name: fixup_interface
methods.description: Adjusts the interface configuration based on its type and possibly associated devices.

methods.name: scan_interfaces
methods.description: Loads network configuration and runs fixup on each interface.

methods.name: prepare_interface_bridge
methods.description: Prepares a bridge interface by calling ubus.

methods.name: setup_interface
methods.description: Adds a device to a network interface via ubus.

methods.name: do_sysctl
methods.description: Sets a sysctl parameter if provided with a value.
